offering_description.value: Provides investor communications, proxy and regulatory document distribution, and technology-driven post-trade processing and wealth platforms to banks, broker-dealers, asset managers and public companies. Delivers via its own software platforms, processing operations and print/digital communication services.

primary_products.value: investor communications software; securities processing platforms; wealth management software; fund distribution data tools

primary_services.value: proxy and shareholder communications; regulatory and customer communications; securities clearing and settlement processing; business process outsourcing; data and analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, broker-dealers, asset and wealth managers, mutual funds, public companies and corporate issuers

end_markets.value: capital markets; wealth management; asset management; banking; corporate issuers

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-event fees for proxy distribution, trade processing and communications volumes; subscription: recurring fees for software platforms and managed services; service fees: outsourced processing, print and digital communication services; project or contract: implementation and customization of technology solutions
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates SaaS platforms for trade processing and wealth management, sold to financial institutions; service provider: processes investor communications and outsourced back-office operations for financial firms and issuers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, largest operations in US and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: investor communications and global technology and operations (post-trade processing, wealth platforms) for financial firms

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to financial institutions, funds and corporate issuers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: SEC and FINRA rules on proxy delivery and broker-dealer processing, registered clearing and broker-dealer subsidiaries, data privacy
